configuration.cohort_policy: All108 frozen queries start fresh; no results or timings imported from results/m6 or engineering matching
configuration.cut_infrastructure: zrhfd.experimental_cut_workspace.installed_workspace; process-local opt-in only around complete pipeline.run; same exact integer reduction and main Config
configuration.execution: serial fresh child process per query; whole process group monitored
configuration.offline_evaluation: truth opened only after pipeline.run returns; full truth community coverage, rho, outside-region volume, output quality, hull quality and target size/volume recorded; no extra diagnostic diffusion

timing.censoring: timeout/memory/error records are not completed measurements; completed-only slopes are descriptive and cannot alone establish G-E3
timing.compile: numba_compile_or_cache_seconds: explicit dispatcher.compile for the exact readonly CSR signatures before method input load
timing.input: input_load_seconds: readonly mmap CSR shape/degree validation; no truth or edge materialization
timing.primary: method_hot_wall_seconds: outer wall around installed_workspace context and complete pipeline.run, including workspace preparation/assembly/validation, diffusion, sweep, MM, certificate, output statistics/components, and progress checkpoint I/O
timing.total: parent_process_wall_seconds: process startup, imports, source verification, signature warmup, input load, full method, offline truth evaluation, raw serialization, interpreter shutdown
timing.toy: toy_pipeline_warmup_seconds: full unlabeled toy execution after compilation, includes mincut backend initialization

configuration.warmup: unlabeled fixed ring CSR with readonly int64 offsets, int32 neighbors, float64 weights/degrees; explicitly compile/cache-load both diffusion signatures, then execute the full main pipeline
